name: print-social-desktop-folder-designer-portfolio-cover-large
title: Designer portfolio cover with script overlaying heavy sans and a huge blue folder
whatItIs: A cream slide with a large heavy chocolate 'portfolio' word overlapped by a blue script 'designer' and a translucent big blue folder with a cursor, italic '(2025)' beneath, and scattered desktop items: folders, Notion and Figma icons, Safari icon and file thumbnails of the designer's projects.
whatItMeans: Friendly, clever and orderly; the folder metaphor doubles as a table of contents.
techniques: Overlap a script word on a bold sans word for depth.
Let the folder sit in front of part of the letters, semi-transparent.
Use project thumbnails with filenames as a contents list.

vocabulary.definition: A script word laid over a heavier word.
A small image labelled like a file.
A layout that also acts as a table of contents.
